name: Ironpass Former Combat Medic Bartender's Shift Set
description: Dark utility trousers with medical-kit loop webbing still sewn into the left thigh, now holding a bottle opener and a rag instead of trauma shears. A plain olive henley with the sleeves always rolled precisely to the elbow — a habit from sterile procedure — revealing a forearm with two mismatched chrome fingers on the left hand. A low-profile apron in black canvas, front-pocketed, worn with the same economy of movement as body armor.
functionality: Medical loop webbing repurposed for bar tools; chrome fingers provide non-slip grip on glassware in any weather.
what_it_says: Someone who has seen worse than anything this bar will throw at them, and is quietly fine with that.
manufacturer: Ironpass (trousers base); apron sourced locally; chrome from Vansen AugMount
story_hooks: The medical webbing loops are from a specific theater of conflict — a regular at the bar served in the same unit and hasn't said anything yet.
Someone comes in tonight with a wound that needs immediate attention, and the bartender's hands remember exactly what to do.
